Game Overview

In Numeric Logic, the core idea is straightforward: unleash your numeric prowess in Numeric Logic. Aim, shoot, and watch numbers crumble as you strategically erase blocks before they descend. With escalating complexity, sharpen your reflexes and enhance your tactics. Unlock bonuses and set new records in this thrilling number-breaker challenge!
